note: MacPython-OS9 2.3.5 (2005, with PIL, Numerical, img): its Installer VISE, Easy Install; needs CarbonLib (tools-9.0.4 has 1.6). The install location is drawn by PowerPC code the text feed doesn't see, so Switch Disk is pressed three times (Macintosh HD, Host, then the target: the order the volumes mount in) and "expect" checks where it went. ConfigurePython copies PythonCore into Extensions (the target isn't the startup disk) and rebuilds the applets; the applets it rebuilds differ every run (volatile)

steps.note: the alert that the Finder will be busy: it takes clicks only once the applets are rebuilt
